On the ground today at the Africa Energy Forum, there is a lot of discussion around the urgency of closing the energy access gap and accelerating energy transitions through development finance. 

Our solution is to focus on systemic approaches to de-risk private sector investments. Specifically we’re: 

1. Tackling systemic barriers like debt crises and investment risks
2. Prioritizing innovative financing tools
3. Utilizing blended finance models that merge public and private capital

Reach out to us to learn more about UNDPs  Energy Offer.
